title: Resolving Vibrational Modes at the FeSe/SrTiO3 Interface with Atomic-Scale Momentum-Selective Dark-Field EELS
content: The sub-10 meV energy resolution [1] and dark-field detection [2] have enabled the investigation of local vibrational properties by electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) down to the atomic scale [3, 4]. However, the momentum integration of a finely focused electron beam imposes limitation on the information that can be extracted from vibrational EELS. For materials with heavy elements and complex phonon dispersions, understanding the vibrational spectrum can be challenging. Recently, momentum selectivity has been demonstrated in dark-field vibrational EELS [5], which introduces an additional parameter for vibrational signal acquisition.
